record: Lead House sponsor, with Rep. Yvette Clarke and Sen. Ed Markey, of the reintroduced AI Civil Rights Act on AI discrimination (not catastrophic risk).
grade_reason: Mechanically A: in a September 2026 emailed statement she said AI and billionaires 'threaten humankind', which ruling 1 counts as A. This rests on one rhetorical line whose framing is mainly about billionaires and marginalized communities; all her other AI remarks are about bias and civil rights (D), so a reviewer may reasonably judge C or D instead.
